text.tspan: Top — 4× 2N3904 open-collector switches drive the G-5500 direction inputs (pins 2/3/4/5).
Bottom — Adafruit ADS1015 I²C ADC reads the 2.0–4.5 V position feedback (pins 1, 6)
through 2× identical 100 K / 82 K dividers with 100 nF LP caps.
Configure PGA = ±2.048 V FSR for ~1 mV LSB across the 0.9–2.03 V range.
